knownLimitations: Technical alpha for disposable virtual machines and lab systems; not a production appliance.
amd64 only; no Secure Boot signing, measured boot, or automated full-disk encryption.
No production OpenClaw OS update-signing trust root or first-party OS update feed.
No transactional Debian base-OS rollback and no physical-hardware support claim.
OpenClaw code rollback does not automatically restore migrated application state.
supportedUpgradePaths: Fresh installation only; there is no supported prior OpenClaw OS release to upgrade from.
The installed-system gate exercises pinned OpenClaw application stage, apply, rollback, and reapply transactions.
checksums: SHA-256 checksum assets are attached to the GitHub prerelease and bound in the release-evidence document.
sbom: SPDX 2.3 SBOM attached; it inventories Debian packages, Node.js, the control plane, OpenClaw, and installed production npm dependencies.
signingIdentities: Unsigned lab alpha published through the repository's GitHub Actions workflow; verify the attached SHA-256 checksums and release evidence.
rollbackProcedure: OpenClaw application rollback is documented in docs/UPDATES.md. Reinstall the appliance for base-OS recovery in this alpha.
